chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'a said: Ali narrated from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamza from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj who said:
"The daughters of the son inherit with the daughters."
ai.seo_question: How do granddaughters inherit in Shia Islamic law?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith clarifies the principle of *rad* (return) or proportional distribution by establishing that granddaughters through sons inherit alongside daughters of the deceased, preventing their exclusion. This ruling is foundational in Shia jurisprudence for resolving conflicts between primary heirs (like daughters) and secondary heirs (like granddaughters), ensuring equitable shares based on lineage. It underscores the Shia emphasis on detailed genealogical distinctions in inheritance law, differing slightly from some Sunni schools regarding the exclusion of granddaughters when daughters are present.
